page.overview:
What is Samba Island?

Samba Island is a non-canon island in the New World, previously protected by the Whitebeard Pirates and later ruled by Chameleone as a tyrant. It became autonomous once Chameleone was ousted.

Samba Island's geography is similar to the structure of 's stage. Not much is known about it.

The only named citizens of the island are Rio and Chameleone, who used to be the tyrant of the island after Whitebeard's death. Rio's brother and other citizens also reside there, but they are not named.

Each year, the residents of Samba Island host an annual . The festival is a specialty of the island and includes an acrobatics tournament. The winner of the tournament receives a prize of the island's Samba Beef.
